unmappedReports: Everything the BMS knows: per-cell balance, over-charge / over-discharge / over-current / short-circuit / over-temperature / under-temperature fault state, and the -10 °C charge inhibit and 60 °C cutout. The contract has `battery-voltage`, `battery-temperature`, `state-of-charge`, `state-of-health`, `cycle-count` — the NLP publishes none of them anywhere., BMS disconnect state. A NOCO NLP that has tripped looks electrically identical to a dead battery, and there is no metric, no indicator and no reset. The guide says the BMS "automatically recovers from fault conditions without user intervention", which is also the reason there is nothing to read.
